data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=msFrOUjWqKwQ7kNvgGZs-qV&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC4aJgbzoPNBS2Hm-Qw19lWNx-T8pLOwbFqZfrkQnDfqw&oe=6755839C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=jnoVsqTYqY8Q7kNvgE6keIQ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB1AxeO6RHdZ0E46XLWGo3bPtI9TB_LSSCUmiNNP2f5uw&oe=67558D24)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qPMkJ7NOEPoQ7kNvgEq9d-j&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCoLzp3vEBrDdZ6QuT7gS03wLkRkpfpQHiotZJK3wS1Xw&oe=67557487)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=dcc2iqjcFH8Q7kNvgFzPn2c&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBkHnH2lnTleVhvPM9eJEzjX1xLw0-RXJQyThgpqY7ULA&oe=67556766)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=mmd5LCkeY24Q7kNvgEoRlzS&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBlt5Ddq0BF6LVHJ-21UXGGdlmDLRZgahF7f7HM587ijw&oe=675593D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=of2AIXFJ4doQ7kNvgFpt-ol&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYClw3rPRoCTbOV0-Q77iIOJPuMG4wmwZGvOcs_KRkcAgA&oe=67559059)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=8Kq-_zxNj4cQ7kNvgEa1pEV&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC3_DWzwnpmFAy9O26sSmSngNremMkvh2jFkURdvEmpkg&oe=67557670)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=zwMAxPthMUQQ7kNvgHe8cnq&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCc0rl8RKozpRdAER_UUfp2x8uaDzGxyNSNuwCXlbN_7w&oe=6755992A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=iYpWEtCSzvYQ7kNvgH61IFD&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCsc9mu3LTAYpaxs4X37_PnZCeTEUTx9PSZO-uzkLcLpg&oe=67557497)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=H6XVLjfmGSMQ7kNvgHbTX-i&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDRr3yKPvZx6KqDzw4eeAM8Dw0zovG8NJm4ffQVsW8Eew&oe=6755900C)
